//: Load on Death. CDDA cannot start a load from JSON, so on death we hold the death off and the player loads with debug menu > Game > Quickload (the Quickload key is compiled out of release builds). CDDA は JSON からロードを始められないので、死亡を保留し、プレイヤーがデバッグメニュー > ゲーム > クイックロードで読み込む（リリース版ではクイックロードのキーが無効）。
//2: u_ldl_pending = 1 while the death is on hold, u_ldl_since = turn it started, u_ldl_final = 1 forces a normal death. 保留中は u_ldl_pending=1、保留開始ターンは u_ldl_since、u_ldl_final=1 で通常どおり死ぬ。
//4: AVATAR_DEATH runs after every PREVENT_DEATH (other mods' revivals) and after the tombstone screen. AVATAR_DEATH は他MODの PREVENT_DEATH（蘇生系）と墓標画面の後に動く。

and.//: Still dead? (Another AVATAR_DEATH, e.g. taking over a follower, may have run first.) まだ死んでいるか（仲間に乗り移った後などは聞かない）。

and.u_query: Undo this death and return to your last save?  (No: die as usual)

effect.u_message: Your death is on hold.  To go back to your last save, open the debug menu and choose Game… → Quickload.  If the debug menu has no key, set one in the keybindings menu (Esc menu).  If time passes first, you die again.  A save made now ends in death when loaded.

//: No playing on while dead: if 5 seconds pass without loading, die again (the question comes back). 死んだまま遊ばせない。5秒経ってもロードしなければ再び死ぬ（質問も再表示）。
This save was written while the death was on hold (manual save or autosave): there is nothing to go back to, so the character dies. 死亡保留中に書かれたセーブ（手動・オートセーブ）。戻る先が無いので通常どおり死亡させる。

effect.u_message: This save was made after your death.  Your character dies.
